final: WITH pg AS (SELECT P.ID AS id, P.SEX AS sex, AVG(1.0*L.TAT2 / L.TAT) AS a FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), sg AS (SELECT sex, AVG(a) AS sa FROM pg GROUP BY sex), ov AS (SELECT AVG(sa) AS oa FROM sg) SELECT sg.sex, sg.sa, sg.sa - ov.oa FROM sg JOIN ov ON ov.oa IS NOT NULL WHERE sg.sa > ov.oa
